title: Board of Peace Warns UN Security Council Gaza Ceasefire Could Collapse
detail: The US-backed Board of Peace told the UN Security Council the Gaza ceasefire, in force since Oct 10, 2025, faces collapse without immediate implementation steps. It said 'a ceasefire that delivers nothing visible cannot be sustained indefinitely', cited Israeli airstrikes, aid restrictions before winter and funding shortfalls, and said Israel has blocked the interim civil administration and not decided on civilian police deployment. It urged the Council to press both sides to meet commitments.
